subject: gk
question:
Match the following dams with the rivers on which they are built.

 
 

 
 
a.

 
 
 
Hirakud Dam

 
 
 
(i)

 
 
 
Chambal river

 
 
 

 
 
b.

 
 
 
Nagarjuna Sagar Dam

 
 
 
(ii)

 
 
 
Narmada River

 
 
 

 
 
c.

 
 
 
Sardar Sarovar Dam

 
 
 
(iii)

 
 
 
Krishna River

 
 
 

 
 
d.

 
 
 
Tehri Dam

 
 
 
(iv)

 
 
 
Mahanadi river

 
 
 

 
 
e.

 
 
 
Rana Pratap Sagar dam

 
 
 
(v)

 
 
 
Bhagirathi river

options.text: a - iii, b - iv, c - ii, d - v, e - i
a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - v, e - i
a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - i, e - v
a - i, b - iii, c - ii, d - v, e - iv

solution:
The correct answer is __**a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - v, e - i.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hirakud Dam:** This dam is built on the **Mahanadi river** in the state of Odisha. Hence, a matches with iv.
 
• **Nagarjuna Sagar Dam:** This dam is constructed on the **Krishna river** and is located in the states of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Hence, b matches with iii.
 
• **Sardar Sarovar Dam:** This dam is built on the **Narmada river** in the state of Gujarat. Hence, c matches with ii.
 
• **Tehri Dam:** This dam is constructed on the **Bhagirathi river** in the state of Uttarakhand. Hence, d matches with v.
 
• **Rana Pratap Sagar Dam:** This dam is built on the **Chambal river** in the state of Rajasthan. Hence, e matches with i.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hirakud Dam:**__

 __
 
• Hirakud Dam is one of the longest dams in the world, with a length of about 25.8 km.
 
• It is a multipurpose dam providing irrigation, flood control, and hydroelectric power.
 
 
 
• **Nagarjuna Sagar Dam:**__
 __
 
• Nagarjuna Sagar Dam is one of the largest and tallest dams in India.
 
• It is primarily used for irrigation and hydroelectric power generation.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Sarovar Dam:**__
 __
 
• Sardar Sarovar Dam is part of the Narmada Valley Project aimed at providing water for drinking, irrigation, and hydroelectric power generation.
 
• The dam has faced significant environmental and social controversies.
 
 
 
• **Tehri Dam:**__
 __
 
• Tehri Dam is the tallest dam in India and one of the tallest in the world.
 
• It is a multipurpose rock and earth-fill embankment dam.
 
 
 
• **Rana Pratap Sagar Dam:**__
 
 
• Rana Pratap Sagar Dam is part of the Chambal Valley Projects.
 
• It provides water for irrigation, hydroelectric power, and industrial use.
